Multiplier-bootstrap maximum test from debiased influence scores

Source: R/inference.R
max_test_hd.Rd

The function requires only coordinatewise score variances. It does not form or invert a q by q covariance matrix and therefore permits q > n.

Usage

max_test_hd(
  theta_tilde,
  target,
  psi_centered,
  alpha = 0.05,
  bootstrap_B = 999L,
  bootstrap_seed = NULL,
  multipliers = NULL,
  block_size = 256L
)

Arguments

theta_tilde

Debiased target estimates.

target

Null target vector.

psi_centered

Centered n by q influence-score matrix.

alpha

Test level.

bootstrap_B

Number of Gaussian multiplier draws.

bootstrap_seed

Optional reproducible seed. The caller's RNG state is restored after multiplier generation.

multipliers

Optional fixed n by bootstrap_B multiplier matrix.

block_size

Number of draws processed together by the C++ kernel.

Value

A list containing the observed maximum, bootstrap distribution, critical value, p-value, separate null-moment calibrations, and the backward-compatible null_energy alias for the null second moment.
